text:
𝗛𝗥𝗜𝗗𝗢𝗬 𝟮𝟰𝟮*! 🔥🇧🇩

Towhid Hridoy's unbeaten 242 off 359 balls is the highest Test score by a Bangladesh batter, passing Mushfiqur's 219*.
Sylhet Test drawn; WI take series 1-0.

What a knock 👏

#Cricket #BANvWI

👉 Towhid Hridoy ne 359 gend mein naabad 242 banaye
👉 Bangladesh ke liye Test ka sabse bada individual score
👉 Mushfiqur Rahim ka 219* ka record toota
👉 Sylhet Test draw, West Indies ne series 1-0 se jeeti

Hridoy ki is pari ko 1-10 mein kitne number doge? Comment karo 👇
